label: supplied structural reference ground
definition: ReferenceGround contains independent maps referent : Token → Object, content : Token → Content and condition : Object → Content. The first assigns a target object to each token; the second supplies token content; the third supplies an object condition in the same content carrier. These maps expose structural inputs, not definitions of causal provenance, productive plans, constitutive anchors or intentional aboutness.
note: Analyst structural meaning for #1380; see docs/notes/form-selection-1380.md. Mathematical fields have explicit bodies. Physical reference-fixing, intentional norms, cognitive adequacy and divine applicability remain OPEN interpretation obligations. No new numbered cognitive sense or actual semantic theory is established.
